analyst.summary: Kirloskar Pneumatic remains a high-quality, debt-free compression-technology business with an improving margin profile and a fresh credit-rating upgrade, but revenue growth has decelerated sharply in the latest quarter (from the high growth rates of recent years to about 10% year-on-year) and the order book is not yet signalling a re-acceleration. We see this as a fundamentally sound company whose valuation was set for a faster growth pace than it is currently delivering.
